notes.content:
Loyal Community,

A new version of GearStorm (v. 1.619) just released that adds integration with Discord to alert you when a player joins your server or when your server starts up. Just add a Discord Webhook to the channel you would like to use for server alerts and put the webhook URL in the "DiscordAlertWebhook=" parameter of the "game.ini" file.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/0f939c25d641ed01a6bb41aef6305705e89ba4b6.jpg[/img]

There are several fixes for quest issues in this release, including AI behavior, text on certain quests, and the ability to finish certain quests.

Please share our game on your Twitch streams, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube channels to support our development!

notes.title: GearStorm v. 1.613 Day/Night Ratio Setting, Auto Graphics Settings
notes.content:
[b]Loyal Customers,[/b]
We are rolling out a small update adding automated system testing and graphics settings to make our first time player experience better and help people tune the game. We also included a very frequently requested feature to change the percentage of the day that is night and persist that setting and the day length setting!

[b]Automatic Graphics Settings When First Starting the Game:[/b]
To avoid issues when first starting GearStorm, we now have a auto-system benchmark running that automatically adjust the initial graphics settings for your system. For those of you that already own the game, your graphics settings may change only the first time you run it after this benchmark. Feel free to go into the options->graphics settings and set things like you want them again and they will persist.

[b]Automatic Graphics Settings Button:[/b]
We have added the automatic system bench-marking tool to the graphics settings dialog so you can benchmark your system and get suggested graphics settings anytime you want.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/ac1a1ce0a2ac90204fed16638588e9e2cc2d0dbd.png[/img]

[b]Night Percentage Setting:[/b]
Responding to our community request to add the ability for the server admin to change the percentage of the 24-hour day of the map that is night we have added a setting to the "Game Settings" screen under the GameMaster menu (backspace by default). This and the other game settings on this screen now persist for all your maps on that server.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/ff5603df9fd80b486fab0a622222a319a31edcfc.png[/img]

The full change log can be found below, if you enjoy GearStorm, tell your friends about it, show it on your stream (We always look for streamers and we'll plug their clips on our social media), share it on your social media, don't be shy to tag us!
--------------------------------------------------------------
Full change log below:
[list]
[*] Adding a option for night percentage on the game setting dialog, persisting day length and night percentage to game.ini when changed.
[*] Changing link to 4NetPlayers
[*] Adding auto-scalability on startup and in graphics options
[/list]

notes.title: Release v1.612 - Performance and Stability Enhancements, New Gamemaster Manager
notes.content:
[b]GearStormers![/b]
We have taken advantage of the last release to the new version of the Unreal Engine for some major performance and stability improvements. We are seeing at least 5-10 fps performance improvements over the last release. Some stability and crash issues relating to losing contact with 3D cards have also been addressed. We also have released our new Gamemaster administration tool so you can add or remove Gamemasters from your server from in-game!

We are continuing to simplify your ability to run your own server and make a unique experience for all of your players. This week, we are adding the Gamemaster administration tool that allows you to make someone a Gamemaster in game by picking their name from a list of players currently logged into your server, or simply typing their Steam ID in the text field and adding them. You can remove players the same way. Adding a Gamemaster takes effect instantly and is saved in real-time as you do it.

notes.title: New Release! v.1.599 - Virus survival, survival map, skills system!
notes.content:
Community members, v1.599 is here! This is huge release with a new infection model that brings the Phage virus into the game, enhancements for campaign mode, a whole new survival mode and map, new content and environmental challenges, the introduction of our new skills tree, and all the bug fixes and performance enhancements we could pack into the release!  This release also starts our automated crash reporting phase as we look to improve reliability for publishing our final release.  Please help us out by sending in those crash reports whenever they pop up!

[h2][b]Enemy-Spawning Nests:[/b][/h2]

Now when you roam the vast open world of Apollyon, in addition to the myriad of different encounters you could experience, you can now encounter nests spawning hordes of monsters and wild beasts!  You can destroy the nest or stalk the things spawned from it for XP endlessly or harvest it for resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/503488d0f58ce5ba1cfdc9e8df37cbe9b6ff3c02.png[/img]

[h2][b]Quest Markers:[/b][/h2]

To make it easier for our players to find their next step in a quest, we have added quest markers that show up on you HUD marking your next objective, happy questing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/5ae62ed05bd57c560f6ccda16aa6471aa81fa3b8.png[/img]

[h2][b]Survive the Virus![/b][/h2]

We have implemented the first phase of our infection by the Phage virus!  Players can now be infected if they take hits from a zombie after their shield is down.  Wearing a helmet or mask reduces your chances of infection.  There is also a cure you can develop for yourself and your colonists.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/52fdb0a4b7cac85b61a100d1bb779b5b8ba378e9.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Vanguard Encounters:[/b][/h2]

We've upped our early game with some combat encounters in the campaign starting phase (Vanguard).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/f622632c5ecae6c2c998f686e7752d8d34fecddc.png[/img]

[h2][b]Less Night![/b][/h2]

In response to feedback from our players we have adjusted the day/night cycle.  Day currently lasts twice as long as night, this can be changed in the game.ini file.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/62b28997ac7d0d8cd33354f037d833ae38e346f9.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Survival Game![/b][/h2]

The new survival experience has been released with a new map, nests and trader cities, ruins and outposts to attack and loot, and tutorial features for new players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/a62e925f07d004b7efdf166f2813c00cc83a3a36.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Skills System![/b][/h2]

The new skills system is here and represents a complete skill tree with perks against certain types of enemies, skills for crafting and using items, much more to come as we build out the skills tree system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34230940/d1ec6b891d3a808ea7a8da4e160b3a92e685fb11.png[/img]

notes.title: GearStorm 1.585 Released!

We added new content to the Campaign allowing with cut scenes weaving the story together.  More of this content will be produced to tell our story with immersive clarity.  Of course, we added the ability for our Gamemasters to add cut scenes to their own stories as well, so make your own videos and show them in your own stories!  There was also a lot of new functions and tools added to the quest editor to support our story and quest development community.

We also have been doing tons of testing on our Campaign story mode and all those bugs have been fixed so you can now play all the way through our main story line!  Also, check out the numerous side quests and stories we have in the Campaign map.

notes.title: GearStorm version 1.556 is here!
notes.content:
GearStormers!

It's release time again with version 1.554 of GearStorm dropping today!  There are tons of bug fixes, performance enhancements, graphics improvements, and new story elements in this release.  We have added a brand new map to GearStorm with the Vanguard spaceship.  Now when you restart a new campaign, you will start on board the Vanguard before where you can take a droppod down to the Apolyon.

Awaiting you after you take one of the drop pods to the planet's surface is a huge new campaign story you can play yourself or with friends.

This version of GearStorm has been through tons of polishing, new features, and the campaign story has been expanded with lots of new side quests and a continuation of our main story line.  Also, we added a lot of new tutorial and help functions to help our new players out.  There's a simulator on-board the Vanguard that transports you to a simulated "play-world" where you can learn how to use vehicles, tools, machines, weapons, and other survival skills.

There's now a difficulty option on the campaign and hosting screens so you can choose your own difficulty.

We added Sentinel Combat Drone, for talking and fighting.  Bandits now have a variety of weapons, Gasmasks can be harvested off some bandits.

New effects for the VTOL were added and cockpit screens got a overhaul.

You can now press "Delete" to abort placing a block. This is useful for removing blocks since now you can pick a block up and hit "Delete" to throw it away. Mapped as "Abort" key in the keymapper if you want to change it..

The Save/Load system got a revamp, the game saves as you play, and you can now hit "f7" to bring up the save/load menu and save a snapshot of the game and your character to a new directory. 

We added the "Placing NU-You" station on Vanguard so you can change your character look.

Night vision is now in the game in some helmets (just hit "v") as well as throwable flares to light up a area at night.  We also added localized lighting to help our players get around in the darkest of nights.

Combat was re-balanced against AI to make weapons more powerful and survival more achievable!

Our musical score is also complete, we hope you enjoy the music!

We also added a new HUD for the drop pod to make it easier to see your velocity when dropping in.

Animations got a re-vamp with new running, arm movements, and tons of refined animations across the board.

New creatures and new guns! New Hunting Rifle, Bandit Rifle, Railgun, and Legacy AR. 

There is now a mineral scanner that shows on your map where minerals are.

Keymapper was changed to have more descriptive names for keys.

Your Squad members now show up on your map.

You can now crush things with your drop pod!  Happy hunting.

Vehicle convergence was revamped to aim both weapons at the cross-hair range.

There's a new map for survival, Austrasia, unique terrain for a survival experience.

You can now hit "escape" to close any menu screen.

Quest replication between network users was fixed to continue our support of multi-player quests and campaign.

The Quest journal has been re-worked to show multi-player quest log history.

notes.title: GearStorm 1.520 Release!
notes.content:
Brand new GearStorm release today!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/6afc98652e9e03bb79e052140dd129497d27a44c.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/3a246ce49451d693652692566755918487c1259e.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/da4a3c7fa10a9155c59584ea5d9c42267847ed2d.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/ee97b864586dd49c44a1f5d3792522707b36bbc5.jpg[/img]

Today marks a very big shift in the direction of GearStorm.  With some new partnerships, we have a completely new game in terms of graphical quality. We have completely replaced all of the lighting, player 3D model, world and building graphics, and added multiple new types of plants and trees. This game now looks like a completely different game. We upgraded GearStorm to the latest version of the Unreal Engine that gave us a huge performance boost for graphics and frames. Also, we have brand new functionality for:
[list]
[*] Customize your avatar! You can now change out your helmet, face and sex of your in-game character, this is only the beginning of the customization options we will be adding.
[*] Editing the spawn rates for different enemies in the admin menu.
[*] Vehicle specifications can now be set by admins per server from the admin menu GUI, change all the vehicle speeds, capacity, armor, etc for your server right from inside the game using the admin menu.
[*] The in-game map now includes zoom and labels for the mineral deposits that are near you, greatly simplifying resource gathering!  Look for the periodic chart symbol on the minimap and main map for the mineral you are looking for.
[*] The in-game mission building system, showcased in the tutorial that is the first part of the "campaign" game mode has been redone with the ability to put videos in the mission briefing and using local and online web content (optionally).
[*] The tablets in-game have been given the ability to use web content both locally and online including videos.
[*] Female character option was added.
[*] Un-armored character added, separating armor and power armor as a pickup craftable item.
[*] You can now issue commands to your NPCs (alt-e by default)
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/1213089b76e527699e6feea44c430f56964e4832.jpg[/img]Un-armored starting character and female character option

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/f9ec48a4ecd4d4f7e4802af91fd3fbc48b94fc0a.jpg[/img]Edit AI spawn rates in real-time in-game

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/87375396f4ed8710be87aea726bc2d1bc1fc98c8.jpg[/img]Edit vehicle stats in real-time in-game

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/f3d716b6b0dce72360de7a6892aff531b5fcf3c2.jpg[/img]Change out your helmets

notes.title: 1.518 Release!
notes.content:
GearStormers! We have a big new release today! Our developers are hard at work making GearStorm as good as we can make it before it is released on the market. 

You can join our discord server (https://discord.gg/wdGnzYe) and on our corporate server to welcome our new players.

[b]On to what is new in this release:[/b]

With this release we have moved to a new Engine version, Unreal 4.22.1.  The big difference is the 60% graphics draw speed, that has improved GearStorm performance to the point where we can include another level of graphics quality and maintain our frame-per-second performance. 4.22.1 also includes numerous bug fixes and performance enhancements. 

After community feedback, we have engaged with some new resources to help us with a complete graphics overhaul of the game, the surface of our objects, many building materials have been redone to show more detail and light better. We have also redone our lighting and fog in our world to look more realistic. Next, we plan to redo some models of plants, grass, and trees, the surface of some of our terrain, and some effects.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/024668a3fd265fb3efffdf17f235ea8579bbd574.jpg[/img]
 
We added a new category of quality settings for graphics of “Cinematic” for those of you with video cards that can deal with that level of performance (it runs fine in our testing on a Nvidia GTX 1060 or above).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/a234aea27e7207303d2667d88946a1636c422461.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/ef2b24b002d593340afa59b88fbbe71c17e85151.jpg[/img]
 
We added options to our weapons for fire modes, you can set rockets to explode at a certain range, change your rate of fire, change your velocity, all in the field.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/f5fd1430c5fd8644a66ff542c833276fffe9ee28.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/0d65ff6169e3182af335ab23c580b37ad427b556.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/7b9ec3c485473245f6f2246224528424abda248f.jpg[/img] 

For our new players we added “help tablets” in the world and some additional text to help people understand the quests.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/a0702fcb429c26ae6fc9d9631304b9900e631c9a.jpg[/img]
 
Respawning chests have been added that automatically respawn loot when the loot is taken after a delay. Admins can create these on their servers and place them wherever loot drops are desired!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/22390818d44b3b8d00bef5cc45867db8e48bdb87.jpg[/img]
 
A new type of enemy was added (the Sentinel) and several of our advanced AI got a re-skin.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/d427572820e9d0cdc3954c93c0603055e5cff21b.jpg[/img]
 
We also added a map legend for our map to make it more clear for new players what is where!

notes.title: GearStorm 1.516 Release!
notes.content:
GearStorm 1.516 is here!  Tons of new content, features, performance increases, and fixing some vehicle replication rubber-banding and snap-back issues.  Many thanks to our test-pilot, John Byrd for giving us some direction on drop-pod effects and graphics settings!

You can now configure your own mech after you build it:

Just park it on the vehicle spawn pad, walk up to it and press “alt-e”.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/d807dc62969402394569ab5bab7bb242b9a1e5e6.png[/img]

Also, we added the camo switcher, now you can change your camo for your vehicles, weapons, and your power armor:

Just press “I” for inventory and click the “settings” icon to change your armor camo:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/f8af0ba7964dc12bd8dff4b2e0030b7d291c39e7.png[/img]

Then pick your look!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/5332377dd892f0163cbedd92d62923236e975ee3.png[/img]
 

For your weapons, press “q” while holding the weapon you want to configure and click the “camo” button:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/09be777f4488ec3b68345170e8ff37d74fdb441e.png[/img]

Then pick your weapon paint!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/a180de1ce9d5b517999dd138a09ba204f95d8e2e.png[/img]

We have also overhauled our vehicle simulation weapon switching and cockpit displays so you can see which weapon you have slected and selectom more than one (just use the mouse-wheel to switch weapons and/or hold “control” to select more than one to fire at once).  Of course, you can change these keys in the key-remapping.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/061ba95d21617f634d9c2500c3df7e7484907c4c.png[/img]

Also, the main menu has been revamped with new game play modes!

•	Single Player Campaign is the “tutorial” mode you are used to that spawns you in the building, starting the main quest.
•	Survival Mode is the default mode of the game that spawns you in a drop pod to survive in the new world.
•	Creative Mode is the same as survival mode except you spawn in God Mode and with the map open and you can start anywhere on the map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/366cb1392225c861fa1db757400d4300606832c1.png[/img]	 

Based on your feedback, a new, re-formatted graphics settings screen was also added:

Now you can adjust all your graphics quality settings if you are playing on a older rig and need more frames. Reducing the quality of the scene and even dynamically scaling your resolution within your window size or full screen is possible.

Also, you can set “window mode” on and adjust the resolution/size of your window.

Everything persists between games.	

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/965bccb810b79e329a5dd1d419b1b8a9498983af.png[/img] 

Effects were improved on the drop-pod and across the board:
  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/b7c298d483a5d2395fbfb009e2b5be96dd0e631c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/7b64cfe526942f3cbdb9d2251724a516e863664f.jpg[/img]

The big news (and effort) for this release was that we totally redid our building system to reap massive 60% gain in processor capacity, this allows us to have way more vehicles, AI, players, and other things in the game all while maintaining performance.  Also, we changed the way physics for wheeled vehicles is simulated, eliminating the “hitching” or “rubber banding” some of you reported.  You should see much smoother performance in general and much smoother vehicle simulation now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/920e9885cbe5ac7de2c94c4ea750e33a316c1eaf.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/067ff35c0107b214b8d944c062d88292fcdc145d.png[/img]

There is also a new IFF indicator that shows your name and honor score:
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/02f7f4f67c2ec6b9328a856180278dd5446035ec.png[/img]

If you turn it on in your player config:
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34230940/734d611b269bbe4dffaaf9760cb1be92bcfed2a8.png[/img]

Tons of additional bug fixes and performance enhancements have also been done.

Next up we will be upgrading performance to increase terrain and block draw speed to give everyone a smoother, more seamless experience as they move through the world.  We plan a lot of AI capability improvement to make them persistent and allow even more zombies (and other AI) in the world at the same time!  We plan to continue to deepen the vehicle lab with new options and items to configure vehicles.  We have a new, modular main character model we are about to release that will allow us to show damage and even have dismemberment on the main character, customize different pieces of the armor and paint different pieces different colors.

Our [url=http://kickstart.gearstorm.com]Kickstarter[/url] started today! <<[url=http://kickstart.gearstorm.com]Kickstarter[/url]>>Please support us and help us spread the word!

notes.title: GearStorm Release 1.507

This is a huge release with game-changing features, fixes and additions.  We have a brand new mission-design system for our server admins (which you all are on our corporate server) to create their own missions (accessible from the admin menu and documented on the Gamepedia page.  Oh, and speaking of Gemepedia, we now have a Gamepedia page you can check out here:  (https://gearstorm.gamepedia.com/GearStorm_Wiki). We added weather, snow, rain, fog.  We have a drop-pod that works in you spawn in and is now really fun to fly!  We have a brand new weapon configuration system that lets you attach shotguns to your shotguns or rocket launchers to your shotguns, however you like it.  There are now automated turrets you can build in the game that will defend your base.  Grenades and proximity mines you can throw have been added.  We fixed vehicles so you can crush zombies!  The flamethrower effects have also been improved.  Finally we introduced a load of bug fixes and network tuning that vastly improved performance.  Also, the lighting for the game was fundamentally changed, you should see much better, brighter days and darker, scarier nights.
